name: opencode-docker
description: Dev container configuration for using Docker and OpenCode

scripts.compose:config: npm run projects:generate && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.projects.yml config
scripts.up: npm run projects:generate && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.projects.yml up -d
scripts.rebuild: npm run projects:generate && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.projects.yml up -d --build
scripts.shell: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.projects.yml exec opencode /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh zsh
